primaryRawText:
GX GOLD 750
MPE-7501-ACAAG
80 PLUS GOLD CERTIFIED ATX POWER SUPPLY
GX Gold is the next step in the evolution of Cooler Master’s
entry level 80 PLUS Gold power supply offerings. The
intention was not to create a new product but to improve a
current one to be even more useful to consumers. The
design changes implemented in this series from the MWG
Gold were based on user feedback and demand. New
things were added or changed to make the user experience
better and simpler. Together, these design choices deliver a
great entry level power supply option complete with high
efficiency, reliability, simplicity, and a competitive price
point.
FEATURES SPECIFICATIONS
Highly Efficient Performance : The 80 PLUS Gold certification
guarantees a minimum efficiency of 90%. Cybenetics ETA Rating: ??.
2 EPS Connectors : 2 EPS connectors included with all models for
universal current generation motherboard compatibility.
120mm HDB Fan : 120mm Hydro Dynamic Fan bearing for
improved cooling and noise reduction.
High Operating Temperature : The GX Gold can operate safely at
up to 50 degrees.
Flat Black Cables : The flat black cables take up less space and are
easier to manipulate and hide within the chassis.
5 Year Warranty : All GX Gold models come with a 5 year factory
warranty from purchase date.
